description: Install one or more builds into a project: resolves build dependencies, checks stack compatibility, verifies integrity, copies files, merges dependencies/scripts/.env.example, writes pkg.lock.json. Dependency installation requires install_dependencies=true after reviewing a dry run; npm lifecycle scripts are disabled and pip accepts wheels only. Files and agent configuration can change workspace behavior. Returns integration notes to follow next.

builds.description: Build ids, e.g. ["tneemo/hono-api", "tneemo/hono-auth"]. Put the foundation first when starting a new project.

dir.description: Target directory, created if missing (default: current working directory)

dry_run.description: Show what would happen without writing anything

force.description: Overwrite conflicting files and ignore compatibility problems

install_dependencies.description: Explicit opt-in after reviewing dry_run output and warnings; runs npm with ignore-scripts and pip with wheels only

name: install_builds
title: Install builds
